title: PRISM/A — E: Evolution
description: Architectural decisions (ADRs), migration programs, roadmap items, and deprecations.

evolution.description: The change record for the application architecture — decisions made, programs in flight, planned capabilities, and things being retired.

id.description: Stable identifier. Prefix conventions: 'adr-' for decisions, 'evo-' for migrations and roadmap items, 'dep-' for deprecations.

name.description: Human-readable name for this evolution artifact.

artifact_type.description: Evolution artifact kind. decision = ADR; migration_program = planned source-to-target migration; roadmap_item = planned new capability; deprecation = retirement notice for a component or integration.

status.description: Lifecycle status. active = in progress or enforced; planned = approved but not started; completed = done; cancelled = abandoned.

description.description: What this evolution artifact describes — rationale, scope, or retirement reason.

decision_date.description: Date the decision was made or ratified. Relevant for artifact_type: decision.

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA where the ADR was recorded. Links the decision to source history.

replaces.description: Artifact IDs (components, integrations, or decisions) that this artifact supersedes or replaces.

superseded_by.description: ID of the artifact that supersedes this one. Set when a decision or component is replaced by a newer one.

depends_on.description: Component or integration IDs that this evolution artifact acts upon. Used for blast radius analysis.

owner_stakeholder_id.description: Stakeholder responsible for driving this evolution artifact to completion.

context.description: Background context — what problem or opportunity triggered this. Required for ADRs.

decision.description: The specific choice made. Required for artifact_type: decision.

consequences.description: Expected outcomes, trade-offs, and side effects of this decision or migration.
